unit.pooled_delta_star_warning: per_family_like_for_like pools every real clustering against every control. cluster-control derives its controls from the hdbscan partitions only, so that pooled figure is shape-matched for hdbscan and confounded for k-means, Leiden and the parameterisation variants, whose cluster counts and size distributions differ. Use delta_star_by_clustering, which pairs each clustering with its own control and reports null where none exists.
unit.edge_fidelity_note: edge_* are cluster statistics computed from the unpruned directly-follows graph, not model outputs, so they take one value per partition and cannot vary by model family. They are reported here at cell level for that reason.
unit.selected_best_note: clustered_best_top1 takes the per-cluster maximum over every model family; the global baseline is a single fixed third-order Markov chain. The comparison is therefore not like-for-like and is reported as a selected-best figure. per_family_like_for_like gives the family-matched gains.
unit.delta_star_note: delta_star_* is the estimand: the real partition minus its shape-matched shuffled control. Fitting per family shrinks each model's alphabet, so any partition with the same size distribution earns a gain for free; gain_vs_global keeps that raw figure, delta_star_* removes it. global_baseline_residual should be ~0 -- it scores the same global model on the same test steps under both partitions, so a non-zero value means the n_traces weighting is doing work and family imbalance must be reported alongside the result.

catch_all_share.label: Documento Oficial: Ofício, Memorando, Portaria, Edital, Instrução Normativa e outros
catch_all_share.note: A count over a declared data field, not a model output: no clustering, sampling or seeded step enters it. The analysed denominator is the largest non-control label set, which is every full-coverage clustering and is itself fixed by the feature matrix. Both shares therefore reproduce exactly. The two denominators differ and the two figures are not interchangeable: one is of the concluded population, the other of the population actually analysed.

catch_all_null.contrast_note: Dropping the catch-all raises agreement; dropping any of the next three largest declared classes individually lowers it. The size-matched null cannot separate 'a large class' from 'this class' because no other single class approaches the catch-all's size; this contrast can.

temporal_holdout.note: Each row clusters on features truncated at a fraction of every case's own timeline, then predicts on the full held-out traces. The unmatched rows evaluate different populations, so their gradient mostly reflects the global baseline moving; the matched block rescores every truncation on the cases all four evaluate.

catalogue_sample.note: Illustrative entries from the catalogue, largest and smallest evaluated types. Names are generated (Section 4.7) and unvalidated; measures are for the GRU path on the routing alphabet, the family that gains most on routing (Section 4.8).

index_mechanism.noise_ratio_reading: noise_ratio is 0 for every clustering because HDBSCAN noise is assigned to the nearest cluster by default, so a correlation against it is undefined. These two measures therefore use noise_ratio_refused — what density would have left unassigned, preserved in each clustering's params as noise_ratio_before_assignment. That is the variable the claim was always about: how much a partition abstains, not what survived a policy choice.
index_mechanism.note: Granularity is the relationship that survives scrutiny at this sample size. The coverage rows are largely a restatement of it (partial correlation given median cluster size is small), and the difference between the coverage and accuracy correlations is not resolvable here -- its bootstrap interval over configurations includes zero. The band rows carry only as many distinct silhouette values as there are partitions, not as many as there are clusters, so they are far weaker evidence than their cluster counts suggest.

selection_full_coverage.note: Every clustering is a candidate: no coverage filter is applied, because assigning density noise to the nearest cluster already closed the discard channel upstream. Features are min--max scaled across candidates; accuracy is scored on the common set. Scored on the 'itinerary' alphabet alone --- the alphabets are never pooled, so the deliverable is selected on one of them and that choice is a scoping decision, not a property of the data.

metric_glossary.definition: Share of held-out steps where the model's first prediction is the true next state.
Share of held-out steps where the true next state is anywhere in the model's first three predictions.
top-1 recomputed only on processos every clustering evaluates, removing the coverage confound.
Most-frequent-successor lookup inside the cluster. Floor for 'did the model learn anything'.
One 3rd-order Markov chain trained on the pooled corpus. Answers 'would a single model do as well?'.

The estimand: the real partition's score minus the score of its shape-matched shuffled control (same cluster count, same size distribution, same population, membership permuted). Positive only if the partition carries process signal beyond its shape. Computed per model family, so the comparison is like-for-like. delta_star_adjusted additionally subtracts the global baseline under both partitions, cancelling the weighting artefact that global_baseline_residual reports. It is an ADMISSION GATE, not a ranking: delta-star grows with the number of families, because specialising pays more when families are small and the control preserves shape but not what granularity itself buys. Never order partitions of different granularity by it -- use selection_score for that; comparisons at matched k remain valid.

The pooled global model scored on the same held-out steps under the real and the shuffled partition. Should be ~0 by construction; a non-zero value means the n_traces weighting is doing work and family imbalance must be reported alongside delta-star.

Same cluster count/sizes/population, membership permuted. Floor for 'is the partition real?'. On its own it is the free gain of partitioning, not a result; its distance from the real arm is delta-star.

Per-cluster accuracy minus the baseline's accuracy on the same held-out steps. Measured inside one alphabet against a baseline facing the same vocabulary, so it is the only quantity comparable between representations. It still contains the gain any partition of the same size distribution earns for free, because fitting per family shrinks each model's alphabet — report it beside delta-star, never instead of it.
Normalised Damerau-Levenshtein between the suffix the model generates from a half-prefix and the real suffix. The length ratio says whether a model wins by stopping early.

The same under constrained decoding, where the flow automaton filters every candidate. Emitted only for alphabets whose states carry an action; on a routing alphabet there is no lifecycle rule to enforce.
Share of generated steps (and of wholly-legal generated traces) the process lifecycle automaton allows. The _real pair is the same measure on the observed event log, which is the ceiling.
Fraction of the units a real case visits that the generated path also visits.
Fraction of units in the generated path that real cases actually visit.
Fraction of a real case's visits matched by the generated path. Captures step-level coverage, not just which units.

Mean number of occurrences of each generated transition per cluster member. It counts occurrences, not distinct members, so it may exceed 1 and is not a proportion. The _min variant is the weakest link in the path.

Transitions in the generated path occurring in no sampled held-out trace of the cluster, against a sample of at most thirty. Fabrication, not variation; the measure overstates it for clusters larger than that sample.

transitions_unseen normalised by path length, so a short path cannot look faithful by generating less. The bare key is per cluster; the _pooled key is the population-level ratio of weighted means, and the two are not interchangeable.
Share of held-out traces within 0.25 normalised Damerau-Levenshtein of the generated path.

Mean normalised Damerau-Levenshtein between the generated typical path and sampled held-out traces. The _proc and _itin variants project onto another alphabet and exist only for cells whose states carry both axes.

Exponentiated mean negative log-probability the model assigns to the true next step: the effective number of choices it is still deciding between. oov_rate is the share of steps it gave zero probability and that were floored.

Share of held-out transitions present in the cluster's unpruned directly-follows graph; edge_usage is the converse, the share of the graph's edges the held-out traces use. Both are cell statistics computed at floor 0.0, independent of the dfg model's own pruning. edge_fidelity carries the same three measures contrasted against the shuffled control (real/shuffled/delta_star); because they describe the cluster and not a model they take one value per partition and cannot vary by model family.

Mean pairwise distance inside a cluster. Bounds how close any single path can be to all members. The _proc and _itin variants measure the same spread after projecting onto another alphabet, and exist only for cells whose states carry both axes.
The real trace closest on average to the others. Proximity baseline the generated path must justify itself against.
Density-based cluster validity. Designed for arbitrary shapes; harsh on centroid partitions.
Cohesion vs separation. Rewards compact convex clusters — the shape k-means optimises directly.
Mean worst-case ratio of within-cluster scatter to between-cluster separation, in the UMAP-50 cosine space.
Ratio of between-cluster to within-cluster dispersion, in the UMAP-50 cosine space.
Nearest-centroid distance over a cluster's own mean radius, averaged over clusters. Below 1.0 the clusters touch; below 0.7 they overlap.
Bootstrap cluster recovery over 25 subsample refits. Lower bound: UMAP is not refit.
Share of the corpus inside a cluster that survives the min_traces floor. Captures BOTH discards.

Share a density method leaves unassigned. noise_ratio is what remains AFTER the default nearest-cluster assignment, so it is zero everywhere and cannot be correlated against; noise_ratio_refused (stored per clustering as noise_ratio_before_assignment) is what density actually refused, and is the variable every abstention claim uses. Zero for k-means and Leiden by construction.
Agreement with the declared taxonomy. Reported only; not used as a selection criterion.

unit_recall x top-1 / (1 + transitions_unseen). An explicit composite used as the outcome variable of the validity-vs-utility correlation and as the sort key of the combos tables, so that a single number trades coverage against fabrication. Its components are always reported separately; it has no independent standing.
Min-max scaled combination of common-set accuracy, coverage and silhouette used to elect the deliverable partition; reported under four weightings, and the election must survive all of them.
Per-cluster maximum over every model family. Not like-for-like against the single-family global baseline; family-matched gains are reported alongside.

Paired process-level bootstrap of the anonymised arm minus the raw arm, against the pre-registered margin. Pairing is per protocolo within one algorithm; the split is assigned corpus-wide, so both arms score the same cases wherever both clustered them.

Every aggregate is reported under both weightings: macro/unweighted gives each cluster one vote, weighted/membership_weighted weights by cluster size. A gain that survives only one of them is a property of the weighting, not of the method.
How often the flow automaton actually changes the ranked candidates, the first prediction, or leaves no legal candidate at all.

corpus_funnel.caveat: n_generated counts protocols whose 'Processo gerado' event was executed by a SEAD-PI/... unidade inside the year -- the born-in-orgao definition the article uses. It is not the SEI autuacao field. n_conclusion_event_logged_same_year applies the descricao_replace predicate above and is NOT the article's concluded population. n_corpus_protocolos is PINNED to the corpus the graph actually loaded when corpus_source == 'graph'; n_corpus_in_gold_now re-derives it from the live gold table and will drift, because a case concluded in 2025 can receive a new andamento later and then fail dt_ultimo_andamento < next-year. Report the pinned number: it is what every downstream figure was computed on. The article's corpus is graph-derived: the situacao stage calls a case concluded when it has no EM_ABERTO_NA_UNIDADE edge left at year end. The text predicate used here answers a different question -- 'did a conclusion event get logged' -- and returns a larger number. Report them as two measures, never as one. Neither figure is reconcilable with artifacts/traces, which hold a different slice. n_documents_all_activity counts distinct document numbers over every activity of those cases; n_documents_activity_within_year restricts the activity side to the year, which is the scope the graph load used. The manuscripts' 148,178 is a Neo4j :Documento node count taken from a graph state and a lakehouse snapshot that no longer exist; it sits between these two and reproduces as neither. n_opening_documents_parsed counts parsed_documents/ on disk, the artifact the 12,259 figure refers to. Two counts the article reports and this stage still does NOT produce -- processos concluded without an embedded opening document, and opening documents cancelled at source -- live in the document pipeline, not in sei_atividades.
